body.summary: A hacker called Neo, who has spent years sensing that something is wrong with the world, is contacted by the crew of a hovercraft and offered a choice between two pills. He wakes outside the Matrix, a simulation built by machines to farm human bodies for power, and joins the resistance as the man they believe will end the war. Training, betrayal and a rescue mission follow; ||after Neo is shot dead by an agent, Trinity's confession of love brings him back, and he sees the code of the world and destroys the agent pursuing them.||

characters.name: Neo / Thomas Anderson
descriptors: pale, gaunt, long black coat, small round sunglasses
relationships: Morpheus: recruit and mentor, Morpheus believes in him before he believes in himself
Trinity: fellow crew member who first makes contact and later loves him

characters.name: Morpheus
descriptors: bald, dark skin, round sunglasses, long leather coat
relationships: Neo: treats him as the prophesied One and risks everything for him
Trinity: old comrade who questions his certainty

characters.name: Trinity
descriptors: short black hair, black leather, sunglasses
relationships: Neo: she makes first contact and later revives him with a kiss
Morpheus: loyal subordinate who doubts his faith in the prophecy

characters.name: Agent Smith
descriptors: sentient program, an Agent of the system
pale, earpiece, dark suit, sunglasses, speaks in flat contempt
relationships: Neo: pursues him through the simulation
Morpheus: interrogates him while he is captive

characters.name: Cypher
descriptors: ordinary-looking, tired of the real world
relationships: Morpheus: betrays him to the Agents in exchange for reintegration
Trinity: resents her rejection of him

characters.name: Tank
descriptors: cheerful, guides crew through the Matrix by console
relationships: Neo: teaches him combat programs and pulls him out of the simulation

characters.name: Mouse
descriptors: young, builds a program of a woman in red

characters.name: The Oracle
descriptors: older woman in a kitchen, baking cookies, chain-smoking
relationships: Neo: tells him he is not the One and that he will have to choose

characters.name: The Architect's counterpart, the Agents
descriptors: they can dodge bullets and possess any plugged-in body

settings: The Matrix, a simulated late-1990s city
the Nebuchadnezzar, a hovercraft in the ruined real world
the training construct, an endless white space
a government building lobby and rooftop in the simulation
the real world after machine conquest

arcs.summary: Neo is tracked down through cryptic messages and a meeting with Trinity, then offered the red and blue pills by Morpheus and wakes in the real world.
Neo learns the history of the Matrix and begins training, failing to accept his limits until Morpheus tells him to free his mind.
The Oracle tells Neo he is not the One, and the crew is ambushed when Cypher sells them out; Morpheus is captured.
Neo chooses to go back into the Matrix to rescue Morpheus rather than accept the prophecy's cost, and the crew storms the government building.
||Neo is shot by Smith, Trinity's kiss revives him, and he returns to see the code itself and destroys Smith from inside.||

motifs: mirrors and reflective surfaces, including the mirror that swallows Neo's hand
telephones as exits from the simulation
white rabbits and the phrase 'follow the white rabbit'
themes: reality as simulation and the unreliability of the senses
fate versus choice, especially the choice to believe
love as a force that overrides the system
transformation of the self and chosen names

notable_scenes.summary: Morpheus offers the red and blue pills in a bare room, and Neo takes the red one.
Neo touches a mirror that crawls up his arm and he wakes inside a pod, plugged into the machine harvest.
In the white training construct, Morpheus demonstrates that the rules can be broken and leaps across a gap.
The Oracle tells Neo he is not the One, and he accepts it.
Cypher unplugs crew members and kills them, then makes his deal with the Agents.
Neo and Trinity fight through the lobby and rescue Morpheus from the rooftop helicopter.
||Neo dodges bullets on the rooftop, is shot, and is revived by Trinity's kiss.||
||Neo stops bullets with his hand and destroys Smith, then speaks to the Matrix itself before flying off.||
